# Personal-agent materializer: original upstream notices and modifications

This directory records original upstream texts and exact version relationships for the selected materializer sources. It does not assign a blanket CRAYS license to the source tree.

The [source and modification map](source-and-modification-map.json) associates nineteen captured compiled files with exact original members of openclaw 2026.10.3 and two WhatsApp monitor variants with the separately published @openclaw/whatsapp 2026.10.3 package. The complete compressed npm archives, including trailing bytes, were hashed against their registry SHA-512 integrity values. Each original preimage plus the recorded modifications reconstructed the captured source bytes without executing source programs.

Both packages' registry-published provenance identifies immutable source commit ff338bdb01f2057229b50307ac0a8c1ad8b65a2a in openclaw/openclaw. The exact original root LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES are retained unchanged. Ancestor checks found no separate notice under extensions or extensions/whatsapp. Registry-published provenance was read and its subjects compared; this record does not claim cryptographic Sigstore verification. The WhatsApp source-commit manifest says 2026.10.2 while the published package says 2026.10.3; these remain distinct recorded facts.

The node-edge-tts 1.2.11 original LICENSE and package manifest match the existing speech-inheritance source pins and the integrity-verified original npm archive. This dependency notice is separate from the OpenClaw source mapping.

One captured response-policy.mjs remains origin-unestablished. Its folder name and absence of headers are not ownership evidence. It is not qualified for publication by this record.

The map identifies exact captured/original hashes and per-file change counts. It does not establish every imported runtime dependency, every incorporated third-party implementation, a standalone recovery environment or complete source-offer/rights compliance. Original authorship and notices remain attached to the relevant upstream source. No application, agent, model, provider, build or runtime operation was run for this source readback.
